findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:740 `theorem Pi.basisFun_det_apply (v : ι → ι → R) : (Pi.basisFun R ι).det v = (Matrix.of v).det`; :724 `@[simp] theorem det_map (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M') (v : ι → M') : (b.map f).det v = b.det (f.symm ∘ v)`; mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean:824 `theorem basisFun_toBasis : (basisFun ι 𝕜).toBasis = PiLp.basisFun _ 𝕜 ι := rfl`; mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/PiLp.lean:1196 `theorem basisFun_eq_pi_basisFun : basisFun p 𝕜 ι = (Pi.basisFun 𝕜 ι).map (WithLp.linearEquiv p 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)).symm := rfl`.
findings.fix: State it as `(Matrix.of v).det` (row convention, matching `Pi.basisFun_det_apply`) and prove by `rw [Orientation.volumeForm_robust _ (basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) (orientation_def _).symm, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_toBasis, PiLp.basisFun_eq_pi_basisFun, Module.Basis.det_map, Pi.basisFun_det_apply]`. `areaForm_orientation_apply` then closes with `Matrix.det_fin_two` alone, without the `mul_comm` cleanup.
findings.issue: `volumeForm_orientation_apply` hand-derives the determinant formula for the standard basis from `Module.Basis.det_apply` + `Basis.toMatrix_apply` + `Matrix.ext`, which is exactly Mathlib's `Pi.basisFun_det_apply`; it also states it in the transposed index convention (`fun i j => v j i`), so it does not rewrite against the upstream lemma.

findings.evidence: Lines 459-466: `@[simp] lemma relativeTransverse_transverseBoost ... = relativeTransverse k P`; lines 470-476: the areaForm lemma's entire proof is `rw [relativeTransverse_transverseBoost v b hP, relativeTransverse_transverseBoost v k hP]`. Lines 552-556 (`@[simp] relativeTransverse_transverseIsometry`) stand in the same relation to lines 560-577.
findings.fix: Delete `areaForm_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` and prove the roadmap statement at line 480 directly: `rw [← relativeTransverse_of_plusComponent_eq_zero hb' (transverseBoost v P), ← relativeTransverse_of_plusComponent_eq_zero hb P, relativeTransverse_transverseBoost v b hP, relativeTransverse_transverseBoost v k hP]`. Keep exactly one area-form invariance statement per group (boost, isometry) rather than a general/specialised pair.
findings.issue: `areaForm_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` carries no content beyond the `@[simp]` lemma on line 460: its proof is two rewrites with `relativeTransverse_transverseBoost`, i.e. congruence of `areaForm` at equal arguments, and its only consumer is `areaForm_transversePart_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` (line 480), which can rewrite with the simp lemma directly. The isometry group has the same duplicated pair (lines 560 and 570), both being `relativeTransverse_transverseIsometry`/`transversePart_transverseIsometry` plus one application of `Orientation.areaForm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv`.

summary: The core material (an orientation of EuclideanSpace, light-front components, transverse boosts) is genuinely absent from Mathlib and from EpsilonEridani, but two pieces re-derive existing results: the volume-form coordinate lemma reproves Mathlib's `Pi.basisFun_det_apply`, and `areaForm_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` is a bare congruence of the already-`@[simp]` `relativeTransverse_transverseBoost`. Physlib sources are not in this checkout, so non-duplication against Physlib's Lorentz.Vector API is unverified.
